name: Anolla – Smart appointment scheduling and booking software
author: Developer

sections.description:
Tired of managing appointments through endless phone calls and emails? The Anolla plugin is a complete booking software that transforms your WordPress website into an automated scheduling powerhouse, allowing your clients to book your services anytime, anywhere.

Simply connect your Anolla.com account using a secure widget ID, and embed a sleek, professional booking form directly onto your site with a simple shortcode. This powerful online booking system is the perfect solution for service professionals who want to save time, reduce no-shows, and provide a seamless booking experience for their clients.

Key Features:

  • Effortless Integration: Add your booking form to any page, post, or widget area in seconds using a simple shortcode.
  • Fully Responsive & Mobile-Friendly: Your booking form looks and works perfectly on all devices, from desktops to smartphones.
  • Powerful & Secure Anolla Backend: All your bookings, schedules, and client data are securely managed in your Anolla.com dashboard.
  • Multilingual Support: Reach a global audience. The booking interface supports over 20 languages automatically.
  • Highly Customizable: Control your services, availability, and form appearance directly from your Anolla dashboard.

Who is this booking system for?

Our plugin is a perfect fit for any business or individual that relies on appointments, including:

  • Consultants, coaches, and advisors
  • Hair salons, barbers, and beauty professionals
  • Massage therapists and wellness centers
  • Fitness classes, gyms and sport clubs
  • Tennis, padel and other racket courts
  • Doctors, dentists, and healthcare providers
  • Car services and trade professionals
  • Rental services for equipment or spaces

Why Choose Anolla As Your Online Booking System?

While there are many booking solutions, Anolla is built for simplicity and speed. Unlike other complex plugins, our scheduling software focuses on getting you more clients with less hassle. The setup is intuitive, and you get a powerful backend to manage everything, making it the ideal choice for any service professional on WordPress.

Stop losing customers to busy signals. Start automating your growth with Anolla today!

Setup Instructions

  1. Create an Account: Sign up for an Anolla account at https://anolla.com/en/software.
  2. Activate the App: In your Anolla dashboard, activate the Booking System client app.
  3. Get your Widget ID: Generate a new booking link to get your unique widget_id.

External Services

This plugin connects to the Anolla (anolla.com) service to function correctly. This connection is essential for displaying the booking widget on your website.

  • Service Used: Anolla Booking Software API.
  • Data Sent: When a page with the booking widget is loaded, the plugin sends a request containing the unique and non-personal widget_id to Anolla’s servers to fetch the latest widget code. No user or site data is transmitted.
  • Terms of Service: https://anolla.com/app/legal/terms
  • Privacy Policy: https://anolla.com/app/legal/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin ZIP via WordPress Admin > Plugins > Add New.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Use the shortcode on your desired page: [anolla_booking_widget widget_id="your-widget-id"].
sections.faq:
How do I get my widget_id?

You can find your widget_id inside your Anolla.com dashboard. After creating a booking link in the Booking System app, the unique ID will be generated for you to copy.

What makes Anolla a good online booking system for small businesses?

Anolla is ideal for small businesses because it’s incredibly easy to set up, offers a professional experience for your clients, and has a flexible free plan to get you started. It automates your scheduling so you can focus on growing your business, not managing your calendar.

What kind of support is available for this booking software?

Our scheduling software supports over 20 languages including: English (EN), Czech (CS), Danish (DA), German (DE), Estonian (ET), Spanish (ES), French (FR), Croatian (HR), Italian (IT), Latvian (LV), Lithuanian (LT), Hungarian (HU), Dutch (NL), Polish (PL), Portuguese (PT), Swedish (SV), Russian (RU), and more.

Can I accept payments through this online booking system?

Yes, payment processing is available as part of the Anolla service. You can connect payment gateways in your Anolla dashboard to accept payments for bookings.

Can I customize the appearance of the booking form?

Yes. All customization options (colors, fields, services) are available through your Anolla account dashboard. Changes are reflected instantly.

Is this plugin mobile-friendly?

Yes, the embedded booking form is fully responsive and works perfectly on all devices.

Is the plugin compatible with page builders like Elementor or Divi?

Absolutely. Since the plugin uses a native WordPress shortcode, it works with all major page builders. Just add a “Shortcode” or “HTML” block/widget and paste it in.
